description: HOW TO MAKE VALENTINE’S DAY COOKIES 💗 these are so perfect for a galentines party or a last minute date night idea!  All supplies l!nked in b!o 💕 SUGAR COOKIE INGREDIENTS: 🍪 1 cup softened unsalted butter 🍪 1 cup sugar 🍪 1 cold egg 🍪 1 tsp salt 🍪 2 tsp vanilla extract 🍪 2 tsp almond extract 🍪 3 cups flour Recipe from @Taya Miller⚡️  ROYAL ICING INGREDIENTS: 🤍 4 cups confectioners sugar  🤍 3 tbsp meringue powder 🤍 ~5 tbsp room temp water 🤍 1 tsp vanilla extract 🤍 1/2 tsp Lorann’s Princess Cake flavoring (optional) Double this recipe if you are making more than a dozen cookies! Recipe from @ellygracebakes  Outline icing: slowly add drops of water and mix until you reach a toothpaste-like consistency  Flood icing: slowly add water and mix until you reach a thin, runny consistency  Let me know if you try these!! Hope you guys love them 🤍 #valentinesday #recipe #cookies #lastminute #royalicing
transcript: With Valentine's Day right around the corner, I thought it'd be fun to show you guys how to make these adorable cookies. These are super easy and perfect for a Valentine's party or even a last-minute date idea. I started out by making the dough, scraping down the bowl after each ingredient. The full recipes will be in the caption and at the end of the video for you to screenshot. The dough is done once it starts clumping together and pulling away from the bowl. Then I rolled it out and put it in the fridge for an hour. Now we're moving on to the icing. We're combining half of the powdered sugar and all of the meringue powder. Mixing that with a bit of water and then slowly incorporating the rest of the powdered sugar and water. I would start with less water than you think because you can always add more. I ended up using about four and a half tablespoons. We're gonna mix that for about four to five minutes and then add in the flavoring. Don't forget to preheat the oven to 375. Next it's time to make the icing consistencies. We're gonna do one for the outline and one for the flood. Keep in mind you need a lot less outline than you do flood. Also I would recommend coloring the icing first before you make the consistencies. Unlike how I did for the outline consistency, I added little drops of water at a time until it got to kind of a toothpaste-like consistency. And then for the flood I added a lot more water so that it was a little bit more runny. When you put your spatula down it should take about 15 to 20 seconds to come back together and be smooth. Then it was time to cut the cookies. You want to try to do this quickly because the colder the cookies are, the better they're gonna hold their shape when they bake. I poked little holes in them and then popped them in the oven for about eight minutes while I colored the icing. I kept it really simple with just two colors. Now we're gonna bag the icing so we should have four bags total, two consistencies per color. I'm using these tip-less piping bags from Amazon. I have all my supplies on my storefront. When it comes to cutting the piping bag you want to find the seam, put it in the middle and then smooth out the tip and then cut across in a straight line. Start by cutting a lot less than you think and then test it out. I cut a pretty small hole for the outline. When you're outlining the cookies it's a lot easier to get a smooth line if you lift up the piping bag a little bit from the cookie rather than just dragging it on the cookie. Now that everything's outlined it's time to flood the cookies. This is the most fun part in my opinion. You're gonna take the flood icing and just start filling in the cookie. It doesn't have to look amazing because you're gonna take the scribe and kind of just move everything together. You do want to move somewhat quickly for this. You can also use a fork or a toothpick. You can also kind of tap it on the counter a little bit to get the icing to smooth out. Last but not least you throw some sprinkles on and then just wait for it to set. These cookies are so good. They seem complicated but trust me they are very easy once you get the hang of it and they are guaranteed to be a hit this Valentine's Day so definitely go try them out.
